observer.synthesis: C2PA specification defines manifest structure with claims, assertions, and ingredients. Manifests are cryptographically signed to ensure content provenance and integrity.
FastAPI + c2pa-python integration requires synchronous functions (def not async def) for manifest operations. Critical: c2pa_tool.read_file() is blocking I/O.
JSON-LD uses @context for vocabulary mapping, @type for semantic typing, @id for resource identification. RDF triple model underlies all assertions.
Verification involves signature validation, hash checking, certificate chain validation. Active manifest vs store distinction critical.
Web Components (Custom Elements + Shadow DOM) provide encapsulated UI for C2PA manifest display. Lifecycle callbacks enable dynamic loading.
workspace integration: feedback aggregator for events, blackboard for deliverables, compliance modules for policy enforcement.

findings.title: C2PA Manifest Anatomy
findings.summary: Manifests contain claims (assertions), ingredients (sources), signatures (crypto proof). Active manifest = current state, store = history.

key_concepts.claims: Top-level assertions (dc:title, dc:format, claim_generator, assertions array)
key_concepts.assertions: Typed metadata (c2pa.actions, c2pa.hash.data, c2pa.ingredient, stds.schema-org, stds.exif)
key_concepts.ingredients: Source materials with relationships (parentOf, componentOf, inputTo) and nested manifests
key_concepts.signature: ES256/PS256 crypto signature, X.509 cert chain, RFC 3161 timestamp
key_concepts.manifest_store: Active manifest (outermost) + array of historical manifests showing edit provenance

findings.workspace_relevance: Compliance module validates manifest structure. Blackboard could adopt active+store pattern.

findings.title: FastAPI + c2pa-python Integration
findings.summary: Use def (not async def) for c2pa routes. Library is blocking I/O. Workaround: ThreadPoolExecutor + run_in_executor.

critical_details.imports: from c2pa import Builder, Reader, SigningAlg
critical_details.async_workaround: executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(4); await loop.run_in_executor(executor, Reader.from_file, path)
critical_details.validation: Always check reader.validate_signature() before trusting data

findings.workspace_relevance: All /api/manifest/* routes need sync handlers or executor pattern to avoid blocking event loop.

findings.title: JSON-LD Core Concepts
findings.summary: JSON-LD = semantic layer over JSON. @context maps terms to IRIs, @type declares semantic type, @id identifies resources.

core_concepts.@context: Vocabulary mapping (dc -> http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/). Enables compact notation.
core_concepts.@type: Semantic type (c2pa.claim, c2pa.actions, stds.schema-org.CreativeWork). Enables type inference.
core_concepts.@id: Resource IRI (urn:uuid:abc123). Enables linking and deduplication.
core_concepts.rdf_triples: JSON-LD represents subject-predicate-object triples. Enables graph queries.
core_concepts.compaction_expansion: jsonld.compact() shortens IRIs using context. jsonld.expand() removes context.

findings.workspace_relevance: Blackboard deliverables could use JSON-LD for semantic interop. Feedback aggregator validates assertion structure.

findings.title: C2PA Verification Process
findings.summary: 4-step verification: signature validation, hash check, cert chain, timestamp. Trust levels: trusted, untrusted_sig, untrusted_hash, no_manifest, partial.

verification_steps.1_signature: Verify ECDSA/RSA-PSS signature over claim box using cert public key
verification_steps.2_hash: Verify SHA-256/512 hash of asset bytes matches c2pa.hash.data assertion
verification_steps.3_cert_chain: Validate X.509 chain to trusted root CA
verification_steps.4_timestamp: Verify RFC 3161 TSA timestamp within cert validity period

trust_model.untrusted_signature: Sig invalid or cert not trusted
trust_model.untrusted_hash: Sig valid but hash mismatch (asset modified post-signing)

findings.workspace_relevance: Compliance modules enforce trust thresholds. Feedback aggregator tracks verification events.

findings.title: Web Components for C2PA UI
findings.summary: Custom Elements + Shadow DOM = encapsulated, reusable components. Lifecycle callbacks (connected, disconnected, attributeChanged) enable dynamic manifest loading.

component_patterns.lifecycle: connectedCallback (fetch data), disconnectedCallback (cleanup), attributeChangedCallback (react to src change)
component_patterns.styling: CSS variables (--c2pa-primary-color) + ::part() pseudo-element for external theming

findings.workspace_relevance: iHIM UI can embed C2PA components. Quick Notes shows trust badge. Pattern applicable to other widgets.

findings.title: workspace Integration Architecture
findings.summary: C2PA integrates via 3 systems: feedback aggregator (events), blackboard (deliverables), compliance (policy). Data flow: upload -> verify -> event -> policy -> deliverable.

blackboard_deliverables.pattern: Agent A uploads -> Agent B verifies -> Agent C consumes via blackboard

integration_points.data_flow: POST /api/manifest/upload -> c2pa verify -> feedback event -> compliance check -> blackboard deliverable
